# The versions of the libraries that decide the circuits and the forecasts of the realism study.
# The weekly campaign and the study workflow install with these versions. A new release of a
# library then cannot change a circuit or a result in the weeks of the study. To change a
# version, change it here and record the change in study/PLAN.md.
numpy==2.5.4
stim==1.16.0
scipy==1.18.1
qiskit==2.6.2
qiskit-ibm-runtime==0.52.0
rustworkx==0.18.1
pydantic==2.14.3
pydantic-core==2.50.4
